messages:
devon: Starting bring-up for model horizon-6b (open checkpoint). Goal: fast intake + prioritized runtime checks (attention math, kv cache, quant kernels). Can the ML runtime team run an initial smoke today?

ash: I'll do a quick baseline: fp16 sampling at seq=512, 1k, and streaming resume. Also check per-token latency distribution. Prefer to see p95 < 30ms on A100.

sam: putting int8_symmetric and int4_narrow on the queue. Prioritization: fp16 baseline first, then int8; int4 only if int8 passes embedding fidelity. I'll run L2 + cosine checks for embed drift.

olivia: baseline done on gpu-rt-3 (V100). Observations: generation matches in short contexts but for some prompts with long-range dependencies we see amplitude decay starting ~420 tokens (outputs get more generic). Logs show attention_scale toggles in kernel.

kevin: interesting — could be a mismatch in attention normalization when sequence length > trained context. Did the checkpoint include 'attn_scale' in metadata? If absent we apply fallback 1.0.

sam: metadata has attn_scale=0.999 but our loader truncated to 0.99 due to string->float parse. I'll add strict parsing and unit test.

ash: streaming repro: resume after chunking causes KV length to double in memory for async batching. Repro steps:
```
# repro
stream(prompt, chunk_size=128)
resume(continuation)
inspect(kv_len)
```
Result: kv_len increases by chunk_size * 2.

kevin: sounds like our async append path clones buffer instead of moving. I can add an ownership flag and cheap assert in append path.

devon: add these to bring-up checklist: 1) attn_scale parsing test, 2) async-append ownership asserts, 3) quant kernel layout detection, 4) embedding fidelity gate for hosted.

sam: quant quick notes (int8 per-tensor): +8% latency, lm-ppl +0.015 on PTB. But some tokens show skew in topk leading to different beam picks. Suspect per-row bias not accounted in loader.

olivia: I can produce a small eval set to validate embedding cosines and top-k stability.

ash: loader-transform idea: if quant metadata says 'bias_post_quant' we apply per-row bias correction at load. I'll prototype and bench.

kevin: will instrument runtime to log 'rotary_kind' (none|rope|alibi|other) and 'kv_layout' so we can surface mismatches in intake dashboards.

deploy-bot: model horizon-6b uploaded to staging (s3://redwood-models/horizon-6b/v1) :package:

devon: excellent. Action owners:
- kevin: append ownership fixes + add kv debug logs (end of day)
- ash: loader bias-correct prototype + bench (tomorrow)
- sam: run int8 eval sweep + report embedding deltas (tomorrow)
- olivia: assemble 20-prompt eval set and attach (done)

ciara-bot: gpu-rt-3 reserved 2026-03-20 09:00-10:00 PST for runtime tests :white_check_mark:

devon: once we have fixes, please post a one-line pass/fail and key deltas (latency, ppls, embed-cosine max delta). Keep thread as single source of truth.

ash: will post e2e summary after window. :thumbsup:

devon: thanks all — nice concise bring-up. If blockers ping @devops.
